title: Titanium Pedal Spindle
alloyReason: Grade 5 Ti-6Al-4V (Grade 5, UNS R56400) was selected for this pedal hardware application because its 900+ MPa tensile enables thin-wall lightweighting under cyclic loading. The alpha-beta microstructure provides 45% higher specific strength than 4140 steel, critical for weight-sensitive designs. Its 6.7 W/mK thermal conductivity simplifies thermal management. This rationale is driven by clipless pedal replacement spindle axle and specific design requirements.
process: CNC turning Swiss-type for pedal hardware geometry
Thread rolling DIN 13-1 6g with Class 6g gauge
Go/No-Go ring gauging with Class 6g gauge
surfaceTreatment: Bead blasting 120 grit Al2O3 for matte finish Ra 1.6-3.2um followed by passive oxide stabilization in DI water — tailored for clipless pedal replacement application
commonFailures: Thread galling Ti-on-Ti assembly - prevented by MoS2 anti-seize compound and -20% installation torque — critical for clipless pedal replacement performance

faq.q: What specific material properties make Titanium Pedal Spindle suitable for Clipless pedal replacement spindle axle?
faq.a: Titanium Pedal Spindle uses Grade 5 Ti-6Al-4V because its yield strength, fatigue endurance, and corrosion resistance directly address pedal hardware operational demands. The alloy's specific strength enables mass reduction without section compromise, while the TiO2 passivation ensures long-term environmental resistance.

faq.q: What are the critical dimensional tolerances for Titanium Pedal Spindle?
faq.a: Standard machining tolerance for Titanium Pedal Spindle is +/-0.05mm (ISO 2768-m). Functional mating surfaces are held to +/-0.025mm with Ra 0.8um finish, verified specifically for clipless pedal replacement requirements. Threaded features conform to ISO 965-2 Class 6g, verified with calibrated Go/No-Go ring gauges on 100% of production.

faq.q: Does Titanium Pedal Spindle require any post-machining surface treatment?
faq.a: Yes. clipless pedal replacement components require Bead blasting 120 grit Al2O3 for matte finish Ra 1.6-3.2um followed by passive oxide stabilization in DI water — tailored for clipless pedal replacement application. This restores the natural TiO2 passive layer removed during machining and provides the required surface properties for the specific service environment. Key parameters include surface finish Ra 0.8um and passive layer thickness verification per applicable standards.

faq.q: What quality documentation is included with Titanium Pedal Spindle shipments?
faq.a: Each shipment of Titanium Pedal Spindle includes: (1) EN 10204 Type 3.1 MTR with full chemical analysis and mechanical properties; (2) Certificate of Conformance confirming all processes meet clipless pedal replacement specifications; (3) Dimensional inspection report with actual vs nominal measurements on critical features; (4) Surface roughness certification per applicable standards. FAIR available on request.

faq.q: What is the MOQ and typical lead time for Pedal axle / Pedal shaft pedal hardware components?
faq.a: Standard MOQ: 1 unit for prototype evaluation. Production lead time: 15-25 business days depending on quantity. Rush orders (3-5 days) available. Contact our supply chain team for volume-based tiered pricing.
